home.title: Drop a video here

paste.label: Link to a video

errors.invalid: That is not a link. Paste one web address that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.protocol: Only web links (http or https) can be pasted here. To play a file, use Open file or drop it on the window.

resume.title: Continue watching
resume.text: Recently played videos with previews and the place where you stopped.

audio.none: This file has no audio tracks

quality.failed: The qualities of this link could not be loaded.

panels.playlistHint: Move an entry: drag the grip, or press Alt+↑ / Alt+↓
panels.reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or press Alt+↑ or Alt+↓

plugins.title: My plugins
plugins.intro: Plugins are mpv scripts that add features to the player.
plugins.loadFailed: The plugins could not be read.

row.incompatibleText: This plugin draws its own interface over the video, which clashes with Kaleido’s controls. It may not work properly.
row.duplicateText: Another script that is on has the same name. mpv numbers one of them (for example thumbfast2) and runs both. Turn one of them off.
row.copyOf: Your own copy of the essential {{essential}}. Kaleido sets no options for it, so its previews and other behavior depend on your own script and settings.
row.stopsOnApply: Turned off. It keeps running until you apply the changes.

confirm.question: Uninstall {{name}}? Its files go to the Recycle Bin, and your settings for it stay.
confirm.essential: You can bring an essential back with Restore essentials.

log.label: Errors of {{name}}
log.empty: Nothing was written to the log.
log.failed: The log could not be read.

apply.label: Changes waiting
apply.text: The changes take effect when the player restarts. It continues from the same place.

restore.label: Result of restoring
restore.hint: Brings back the essentials you removed: {{names}}.
restore.blocked: Not restored: {{names}}. A script of the same name that was added by hand is in the way. Remove or rename it, and Kaleido installs the essential at its next start.
restore.failed: Could not be put back: {{names}}. The log says why.

errors.notFound: This plugin is gone. The list was read again.
errors.gone: The plugin {{name}} is gone. The list was read again.
errors.unavailable: The player is not running or could not be restarted. The changes wait for the next Apply.
errors.generic: The change could not be made.

settings.loadFailed: The settings could not be read.
settings.applyHint: A running plugin reads its settings when it starts, so a change takes effect after Apply.
settings.refused: The plugin cannot take this value.
settings.noOptions: The plugin’s settings file does not set any options yet.
settings.foreignKey: Kaleido cannot change this option. Edit the settings file by hand.
settings.keyExists: This option is already in the file. Change its value above.

wants.wholeBetween: Use a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

wants.wholeMax: Use a whole number, {{max}} or less.
wants.line: Use one line, with no line break.
wants.key: Use letters, digits, _ and - for the name of an option.

shortcuts.intro: Every key and what it does, including the ones plugins add. Choose Change, then press the new key; Esc cancels.
shortcuts.waiting: Press the new key for {{key}}. Esc cancels.
shortcuts.reserved: That key belongs to Windows or moves the focus, so a shortcut cannot use it. Press another key.
shortcuts.readFailed: The shortcuts could not be read.
shortcuts.refreshFailed: The list could not be refreshed.
shortcuts.notReady: The player is not ready yet, so its shortcuts cannot be shown.

errors.badKey: mpv does not accept that key. Press another key.
errors.io: The shortcut could not be saved. Check that the settings folder can be written to.
errors.generic: The shortcut could not be changed.

purpose.ytDlp: Opens web links. Kaleido looks for a new version every day.
purpose.deno: Lets yt-dlp read YouTube. Kaleido looks for a new version every week.

updates.checkFailed: The check could not be started.
updates.unreadable: The state of this tool could not be read.
updates.libmpvHint: The video engine Kaleido plays with. It comes with Kaleido and changes with its releases.

about.screenshotNote: A screenshot that a plugin takes with the screenshot command includes the glass. Screenshots from Kaleido’s own shortcuts do not.
about.copied: The diagnostics are on the clipboard.
about.copyFailed: The diagnostics could not be copied: {{reason}}

sources.title: Sources
sources.text: Kaleido is free software under the GPL-3.0-or-later. The libmpv it ships is a GPL build. Every release points to the tag of its sources and to the sources of that libmpv build.

licenses.title: Third-party licenses
licenses.note: The software Kaleido is built on. The full license texts come in a later version.

errors.noDetails: Nothing was written to the log.

playback.title: Cannot play {{name}}
playback.notFound: The file or link could not be opened. It may have been moved or deleted, or the address may be offline.
playback.unsupported: Kaleido cannot play this file: its format is not recognized or not supported, or the file is damaged.
playback.generic: The file could not be played.
playback.continues: Playback continues with the next file.

stream.outdated: yt-dlp no longer understands this website. A newer yt-dlp may.
stream.missing: yt-dlp, the tool that reads web links, is not installed yet or could not be downloaded.
stream.cookies: The cookies of the chosen browser could not be read.
stream.signIn: This website requires you to sign in.
stream.ageRestricted: This video is age-restricted, and the website requires you to sign in to watch it.
stream.geoBlocked: This video is not available in your region.
stream.removed: This video was removed or no longer exists.

streamAction.saving: Saving the choice, then trying again…
streamAction.refused: The link could not be opened again.
streamAction.unsaved: The choice could not be saved, so nothing was changed. Try again.

browser.label: Take cookies from
browser.chromiumCookies: yt-dlp usually cannot read the cookies of browsers based on Chromium on Windows, and the link then fails as a whole. Firefox works.
browser.noProfile: No profile with cookies was found.
browser.empty: No browser was found whose cookies can be used.
browser.failed: The browsers could not be listed.

plugin.title: Plugin {{name}} reports errors
plugin.message: It keeps running. Kaleido turns nothing off by itself.
plugin.off: {{name}} is turned off. This takes effect after Apply.

errors.pasteEmpty: There is no link on the clipboard. Copy a web address (http:// or https://), then press Ctrl+V.
errors.dropLink: The dropped link could not be opened. It has to be one complete web address that starts with http:// or https://.
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside Kaleido. It is written in the log; if the player stops responding, restart Kaleido.

recover.title: Kaleido's window ran into a problem
recover.text: This view stopped working, and what happened is written in the log. Reload it to go on; what plays keeps playing.
